Game Overview

In Brainrot Attack, the core idea is straightforward: pilot a flying crocodile, dodging chaos as you unleash quirky firepower. Navigate relentless enemy waves and snag power-ups in this zany test of reflexes. As the madness escalates, sharpen your focus and revel in meme-fueled fun. How long can you survive this wild ride?
